---
title: "What design maximises time aloft under a real launch?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
best, res = optimise_launch(maxiter=200)
d = dict(zip(LAUNCH_BOUNDS, best["x"]))

# The two arms it has to beat, each at its own best launch angle.
prev = optimise(static_margin=0.10)
pl, lay = design_geometry(prev)
arms = {}
for label, ballast in [("trim-optimised", prev["ballast"]),
                       ("+1 g patch", prev["ballast"] + 1.0e-3)]:
    tab = aero_table(pl, lay, ballast)
    arms[label] = max((simulate(pl, lay, ballast=ballast, launch_angle=a, table=tab)
                       for a in [0, 10, 20, 30, 45]), key=lambda s: s["duration"])
patch, trimmed = arms["+1 g patch"], arms["trim-optimised"]

assert best["penalty"] == 0                              # the winner is legal
assert best["duration"] > patch["duration"]              # and beats the patch
assert best["alpha_max"] < CLEAN_ALPHA                    # flying clean
assert best["pitch_max"] < CLEAN_PITCH
assert np.max(np.abs(trimmed["theta"])) > CLEAN_PITCH     # unlike ch.01's design
assert abs(best["apex"] - H_RELEASE) < 0.2                # it never climbs
assert best["static_margin"] < SM_FLOOR + 0.01            # the floor is binding
```

::: {.hero}
[`{python} f"{best['duration']:.1f} s"`]{.hero-value}
[time aloft, flying clean, launch and design optimised together]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** Don't zoom. It throws flat — `{python} f"{d['launch_angle']:.0f}"`° —
and spends the launch on distance, covering
[`{python} f"{best['range']:.0f}"` m]{.key} without ever climbing above the
hand. It wants `{python} f"{d['ballast_g']:.1f}"` g of nose lead and a far
longer tail, `{python} f"{d['tail_arm_chords']:.1f}"` chords against
`{python} f"{prev['tail_arm_chords']:.1f}"` (@tbl-design). That buys
[`{python} f"{best['duration']:.2f}"` s]{.key} against
`{python} f"{patch['duration']:.2f}"` s for the ballast patch.

::: {.callout-warning}
## Two things bound this answer
Durations come from a surrogate, good to 1–2%. And the static-margin floor is
active, so a twitchier glider would fly longer.
:::

::: {.callout-tip}
## Specified

2. Ballast free; static margin above `{python} f"{SM_FLOOR:.0%}"`.

3. Nelder-Mead from one start; no multistart.
